sections.label: B
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the words in the box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. I love green, so my father gave me a beautiful ring made of green ___.
questions.explanation: Jade is a hard green stone used for jewelry.

questions.prompt: 2. My tooth hurts. I have to go to the ___.
questions.explanation: A dentist treats problems with teeth.

questions.prompt: 3. I made a pretty vase in art class today. I used ___ to make it.
questions.explanation: Clay is a soft material that can be shaped into a vase.

questions.prompt: 4. My uncle is a policeman. He wears a blue ___ at work.
questions.explanation: A uniform is the special set of clothes worn for a job.

questions.prompt: 5. My brother is a soldier in the ___.
questions.explanation: Soldiers serve in the army.

sections.label: C
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Then match them to the pictures.
sections.note: Write the job, then choose picture a, b, c, or d.

questions.prompt: 1. A ___ is the leader of the army.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: A general is a senior army leader.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture d shows the general in uniform.

questions.prompt: 2. A ___ visits places on vacation.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: A tourist travels to and visits places for pleasure.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture a shows a tourist visiting Paris.

questions.prompt: 3. A ___ is a person who rides a bicycle.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: A cyclist is someone who rides a bicycle.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture c shows the cyclist.

questions.prompt: 4. Long ago, a ___ was a poor farmer or farm worker.

parts.label: Missing word
parts.explanation: Historically, a peasant was a poor farmer or agricultural worker.

parts.label: Picture label
parts.explanation: Picture b shows the peasant working in a field.

sections.label: D
sections.title: Rewrite the sentences with infinitives. Use the words in parentheses.
sections.note: Keep the original meaning and use to + base verb.

questions.prompt: 1. They liked the movie. (seem)
answers: They seemed to like the movie
They seemed to like the movie.
questions.explanation: Seem is followed by a to-infinitive: seemed to like.

questions.prompt: 2. We learn a lot about dinosaurs. (expect)
answers: We expect to learn a lot about dinosaurs
We expect to learn a lot about dinosaurs.
questions.explanation: Giữ thì hiện tại của câu gốc; dùng expect + to + động từ nguyên mẫu.

questions.prompt: 3. She labeled the chart correctly. (learn)
answers: She learned to label the chart correctly
She learned to label the chart correctly.
questions.explanation: Learn is followed by a to-infinitive when it means acquiring a skill: learned to label.

questions.prompt: 4. I did my homework. (decide)
answers: I decided to do my homework
I decided to do my homework.
questions.explanation: Decide is followed by a to-infinitive: decided to do.

sections.label: E
sections.title: Complete the sentences for each set of pictures. Use infinitives.
sections.note: Use the cue below each picture and complete the sentence.

questions.prompt: 1a. He promised ___. (study harder)
questions.explanation: Promise is followed by a to-infinitive: promised to study harder.

questions.prompt: 1b. She promised ___. (clean her room)
questions.explanation: Promise is followed by a to-infinitive: promised to clean her room.

questions.prompt: 2a. He decided ___. (play soccer)
questions.explanation: Decide is followed by a to-infinitive: decided to play soccer.

questions.prompt: 2b. She decided ___. (make dinner)
questions.explanation: Decide is followed by a to-infinitive: decided to make dinner.

sections.label: F
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make sentences.
sections.note: Use every word and write a complete sentence.

questions.prompt: 1. dishes / to / He / wash / promised / the
answers: He promised to wash the dishes
He promised to wash the dishes.
questions.explanation: The correct order is: He promised to wash the dishes.

questions.prompt: 2. to / She / bike / fix / her / tried
answers: She tried to fix her bike
She tried to fix her bike.
questions.explanation: The correct order is: She tried to fix her bike.

questions.prompt: 3. do / homework / to / I / forgot / my
answers: I forgot to do my homework
I forgot to do my homework.
questions.explanation: The correct order is: I forgot to do my homework.

questions.prompt: 4. the / seemed / They / enjoy / to / festival
answers: They seemed to enjoy the festival
They seemed to enjoy the festival.
questions.explanation: The correct order is: They seemed to enjoy the festival.

sections.label: G
sections.title: Complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use the words in the box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. My favorite ___ is to explore the fields around my house.
questions.explanation: A pastime is an activity done for enjoyment.

questions.prompt: 2. I like to ___ rocks and bones up close.
questions.explanation: Examine means look at something carefully.

questions.prompt: 3. Some rocks have many ___ in them.
questions.explanation: Layers are levels of material lying one over another.

questions.prompt: 4. I hope I ___ a special, ancient bone someday!
questions.explanation: Discover means find something for the first time.

sections.title: Look and complete the sentences.
sections.note: Use each exact picture from the original test.

questions.prompt: 1. We found an old ___ of a wolf.
questions.explanation: A skull is the bony structure of an animal's head.

questions.prompt: 2. This ___ only ate plants.

questions.explanation: A paleontologist studies fossils and ancient life.

questions.prompt: 4. The big fire created a lot of ___.
questions.explanation: Ash is the powder left after something burns.

sections.label: J
sections.title: Look and write sentences. Use gerunds.
sections.note: Change the cue verb to the -ing form after the first verb.

questions.prompt: 1. The paleontologist began / examine / the bone
answers: The paleontologist began examining the bone
The paleontologist began examining the bone.
questions.explanation: Begin can be followed by a gerund: began examining.

questions.prompt: 2. Thomas enjoyed / explore / the fields around his house
answers: Thomas enjoyed exploring the fields around his house
Thomas enjoyed exploring the fields around his house.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund: enjoyed exploring.

questions.prompt: 3. It began / snow / in the afternoon
answers: It began snowing in the afternoon
It began snowing in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Begin can be followed by a gerund: began snowing.

questions.prompt: 4. We don't like / practice / soccer in the rain
answers: We don't like practicing soccer in the rain
We don't like practicing soccer in the rain.
questions.explanation: Like can be followed by a gerund: don't like practicing.

sections.label: K
sections.title: Complete the sentences. Use gerunds.
sections.note: Use the verbs in the box. One word is not needed.

questions.prompt: 1. The scientist finished ___ the rocks.
questions.explanation: Finish is followed by a gerund: finished examining.

questions.prompt: 2. I enjoy ___ pictures of nature.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund: enjoy taking.

questions.prompt: 3. As we started ___ the hole, we found a huge bone.
questions.explanation: Double the final consonant in dig before adding -ing: digging.

questions.prompt: 4. She practices ___ the piano every day.
questions.explanation: Practice is followed by a gerund: practices playing.

questions.prompt: 5. I like ___ songs with my friends.
questions.explanation: Like can be followed by a gerund: like singing.

questions.prompt: 6. It started ___ this morning.
questions.explanation: Start can be followed by a gerund: started raining.

sections.label: L
sections.title: Write the words in the correct order to make questions. Then listen and write the answers.
sections.note: Write both the question and its answer.

questions.prompt: 1. doing / What / he / like / does

parts.label: Question
parts.explanation: Use What + does + subject + like + gerund: What does he like doing?

parts.label: Listening answer
parts.explanation: The recording says that he likes swimming.

questions.prompt: 2. she / going / Where / is

parts.label: Question
parts.explanation: Use Where + be + subject + going: Where is she going?

parts.label: Listening answer
answers: She is going to the museum
She is going to the museum.
parts.explanation: The recording says that she is going to the museum.
